label: Bible Study
prompt: The LORD _____; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
verse: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.
note: From David's song of deliverance, sung after God rescued him from Saul — it's echoed in Psalm 18.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked _____.
verse: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
note: Forty years in the wilderness, and Moses's summary is two words long: lacked nothing.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five _____.
verse: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
note: The pool of Bethesda had five porches, crowded with the sick waiting for the moving of the water.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed _____? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verse: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
note: Moses doubted God could feed 600,000 men meat for a month; God answered with a sky full of quail.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all _____ of no value.
verse: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
note: Job to his three counselors: 'ye are all physicians of no value' — bad doctors with worse bedside manner.
